ideas.title: Police Misconduct in the US
ideas.description: Investigate the prevalence of police misconduct in the US, including the Worcester Police Department investigation and the New Kensington officer under investigation.
questions: What is the extent of police misconduct in the US?
What are the consequences for officers accused of misconduct?
ideas.insight: I believe that police misconduct is a systemic issue that requires further investigation. I recommend tracking police departments and officers accused of misconduct to identify potential connections and systemic issues.

ideas.title: Organ Harvesting Industry Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the organ harvesting industry, including the companies and individuals involved, to identify potential connections and systemic issues.
questions: What are the practices of the organ harvesting industry?
What are the consequences for companies and individuals involved in unethical practices?
ideas.insight: I suspect a pattern of unethical practices in the organ harvesting industry. I recommend investigating the companies and individuals involved in the organ harvesting industry to identify potential connections and systemic issues.
